name: Saffron Blue
source:
When Rozenmarine Duvoir begins receiving anonymous letters from an unwanted admirer, she finds herself increasingly uneasy.

Then, one unfortunate carriage accident changes the course of her days. 

[From [url=https://inokinako.itch.io/saffron-blue]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当罗森马琳·杜瓦​​尔开始收到一位不受欢迎的仰慕者的匿名信时，她发现自己越来越不安。

然后，一场不幸的车祸改变了她的生活。

[来自[url=https://inokinako.itch.io/saffron-blue]itch.io[/url]]
